name: Ayana
source:
Yamato's stepsister. She's got a determined but amicable personality.
Though she tends to tease her stepbrother, she actually likes him a great deal.
Unable to act on her feelings, she wants him to take the lead.
Lots of boys at school confess their feelings to her, but she always turns them down.
She joined the cheerleading squad so she could cheer for Yamato.
